task.title: Reporting Suspected Phishing Emails
task.shortdesc: Report suspected phishing emails instead of replying to or forwarding them.

context.p: If you receive a suspicious email, report it within Gmail and contact IT support.
context.note: Do not reply to or forward the email.

step.cmd: On a computer, open the suspicious email.

info.note: Do not click any links inside the email or attempt to download any attachments from the email.

step.cmd: Click the More or ⋮ option in the top-right corner.
Contact your local IT support or the NC State Help Desk.

info.note: If you have replied to or forwarded the suspicious email, clicked any links inside the email, or downloaded any attachments from the email (even accidentally), then notify the help desk.
